sessionStart.command: sh -c 'OPENSHARD_REPO_HOOK=1; OS=$(command -v openshard 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/openshard"); if [ -x "$OS" ]; then exec "$OS" hooks cursor; fi; echo "openshard: not installed; this event was not captured" >&2; echo "{}"; exit 0'
